# Pablo Díaz-Jorge

> Portfolio of Pablo Díaz-Jorge, software engineer and AI engineer: frontend architecture with Angular and TypeScript, AI agents, MCP and agent evaluation. Contributor to rea and author of rea-lab, rea-casebook and impact-radius.

The site is a single page available in two languages. It lists professional experience and open-source projects, each with a GitHub link and, where available, a live demo.

## Pages

- [English](https://www.pablodiazjorge.com/): about, experience and projects in English.
- [Español](https://www.pablodiazjorge.com/es): the same content in Spanish.
